info.description: A robot arm that picks a part, carries it over the reach distance, places it and works on it. The cycle time follows from the arm's speed, acceleration and payload (Results > Motion shows the time per motion). The cell brings its purchase price as capex for the investment case, its power and a maintenance cost per hour. Its "cell" node is where vehicles deliver to; leave it unjoined in a model with no vehicles.

info.description: The place a cobot watches for people: one node, "zone". Put it where the people come close and join it to the walkways; a Cobot cell in "separation" mode names it as <instance>/zone and slows down while a worker is within the cell's zone radius of it, by path distance.

A collaborative arm working next to people. "collaborative": every move runs at the collaborative speed. "separation": a move starts at the collaborative speed only while a worker is within the zone radius of a Safety zone, by path distance, and at full speed otherwise. Name the zone as <safety zone instance>/zone. The rest is a Robot arm cell.

info.description: Autonomous mobile robots that carry parts between stations, and the ONE block that moves them: wire every station's exit into this asset's "in" port. The robots charge whenever they are idle below 80 % and a point is free, must charge below 25 %, and leave at 90 %. The fleet brings one charger of its own at its "base" node -- join that node to the aisles -- and also uses every Charger in the model. Its purchase price is capex for the investment case.

info.description: AMRs that carry an arm: a mobile cobot brings a part to a Tended machine, puts it in, and takes the finished part out and on. Wire every station's exit into this asset's "in" port, as for an AMR fleet. With "exchange" the cobot has a second holding place and swaps a finished part for a new one in one visit; one cobot without it can stall at a single machine. Battery and charger are an AMR fleet's; the base defaults are the 300 kg AMR class. Capex is base plus arm.

info.description: A machine loaded and unloaded by a Mobile cobot fleet. Name it as a step of the part's routing: the cobot arriving with a part runs the place cycle, the machine works, and the finished part stays in the machine until a cobot has run the pick cycle. Wire "out" into the fleet's "in" port and join the "machine" node to the aisles. "stay" keeps the cobot at the machine until the part is done. A price of 0 is a machine that is already there.

info.title: Automation floor (robot cells, AMR, palletiser)
info.description: Every asset of the Automation library on one floor: a robot arm cell and a cobot cell in line, an AMR shuttle to a palletiser, and mobile cobots tending a lathe. In the results, read the motion summary (each arm's cycle by phase), the fleet's trips and waiting, and the tending summary for the lathe. Illustrative figures.
